sigenergy._source: A real plant's registry and states on 2026-11-13 (config entry id replaced), firmware SPC117, AI mode; the plant maximum and the three reserve entities added from the same registry later that day (the reserves disabled, as there). The plant's and the grid sensor's per-phase power added from the same registry on 2026-11-16 (enabled there that day; states of that afternoon).

alphaess._source: senalse/ha-alphaess-modbus b256f55 (v1.15.0): `<config entry id>_<key>` on every platform (sensor.py line 173, number.py line 65, select.py line 48), the keys from const.py; the device's manufacturer is "AlphaESS" (__init__.py line 94). Not a real registry; built from the source, the battery capacity disabled by default as there.

e3dc._source: torbennehmer/hacs-e3dc 3fd5ab0 (4.0.0): `<config entry unique id, the device's serial>_<key>` on every platform (sensor.py, binary_sensor.py), the keys hyphenated; the day, month and year statistics are `db-day-`, `db-month-` and `db-year-` before the key; the device's manufacturer is "E3DC" (coordinator.py line 867). Not a real registry; built from the source, the signed `battery-netchange` and the idle-period sensors disabled by default as there.

growatt_modbus._source: 0xAHA/Growatt_ModbusTCP 29d6b2b (v2.0.7): `<config entry id>_<key>` on every platform (entity.py line 55), the key the sensor's or the control's name in the register map; the battery's sensors sit on a sub-device of the inverter (coordinator.py line 2616), the inverter's manufacturer is "Growatt"; `battery_power` is signed, positive = charging (sensor.py line 736). Not a real registry; built from the source and const.py.
